why: phase-484 W8c — `nros::RETIRED_ENV_VARS: &[(&str, &str)]` (`packages/api/nros/src/retired_env.rs`): the `(retired, replacement)` pairs `ZENOH_LOCATOR` -> `NROS_LOCATOR` and `ZENOH_MODE` -> `NROS_SESSION_MODE`, deprecated in release 0.5.0-nros2 and now REFUSED. ONE table for both hosted env readers (`nros::env` and the `getenv` twin `nros::host_env`); a set name is `BootConfigError::RetiredEnvVar` / `InitError::RetiredEnvVar`, never ignored, because an ignored locator dials the default router and reads as "no delivery". Public so a test can set the retired name without spelling it (gate `check-retired-runtime-aliases` refuses any other reader). rclrs has no counterpart: it never had the aliases.
